decision: No accuracy benefit of this fixed query-pseudolabel recipe versus matched hard-only student; no threshold/weight followup.
interpretation: Lower logloss does not compensate accuracy loss in this objective. Pseudo/v96 mixture beats v96 alone on this reused dev set but remains below matched hard-only/v96 mixture; cannot attribute that gain to semisupervised learning.
boundary: No query groundtruth to fit_student API, only authenticated foldteacher softprobabilities. Officialtest never entered student input/trainingpool; historical authentication helper reads attribute/provenance files only. All CBM saved/reloaded exact.
reusable_api: fit_student(train_x,train_y,unlabeled_x,teacher_p,seed,use_pseudo=True) exists, but actual full-data fit/export not recommended or executed by this experiment.
